title: Esoteric and occult imagery on NRO mission patches

tellings.quote: Yeah, I looked into a lot of those patches actually which was really interesting. like they have these launch patches, these mission patches at NRO

plain: The cloth patches made for launches by the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, are said to carry mystical and occult imagery. A researcher named Chris Ramsay says he looked into many of these mission patches himself and found them very interesting. He tells it as a hint that hidden beliefs run through secret parts of the government.
